diagnostic_basis.finding: The two multiplicity-significant closure failures both show zero local membership, zero local recruitment, and zero local organized action while future fielded force and foothold strength appear on only one side. This is a transport/arrival signature rather than local endogenous reproduction.
diagnostic_basis.guard: This diagnosis uses no historical outcomes and is explicitly treated as synthetic theory development, not confirmation.

theory_claim_under_test: Local insurgent dynamics require three causally distinct terms: endogenous local reaction/reproduction R, internal spatial transport T of already-existing capacity, and exogenous immigration/support U. Mobility can create local presence without creating system-level insurgent capacity and therefore must not be counted as reproduction.

reduced_form.reproduction_interpretation: Reaction creates or renews local organizational capacity from locally embedded stocks.
reduced_form.transport_interpretation: Transport relocates pre-existing formations/capacity between localities and conserves system-level capacity apart from movement attrition/costs.
reduced_form.external_interpretation: External support/sanctuary injects or sustains capacity from outside the modeled endogenous local reproduction loop.

transport_state_definition.name: inbound_transport_pressure
transport_state_definition.scope: insurgent formations whose current origin can route to the focal locality under the production movement rules
transport_state_definition.committed_component: effective strength of insurgent formations already pending or moving toward the focal locality
transport_state_definition.prospective_component: sum over currently eligible insurgent formations of effective_strength * one-command decision probability * exact expected probability of choosing the focal locality, integrating over the production posture-retention/posture-selection distribution and the production destination softmax
transport_state_definition.purity_requirement: The diagnostic must consume no RNG and mutate no state. It must call or reproduce the production movement scoring logic exactly inside the movement module.

candidate_models.regenerative16v2: competitive14v2 + local renewal potential R_local + organization persistence P

screening_design.analysis: unchanged distributional-closure v2 analyzer and thresholds
screening_design.selection_rule: Prefer the lowest-dimensional candidate that minimizes multiplicity-significant-and-large pair failures; ties are broken by raw practically-large pair rate, then median match distance.

falsifiers.transport_redundant: transport15v2 does not improve closure over competitive14v2 on independent screening support
falsifiers.transport_only_sufficient: transport15v2 performs at least as well as reaction_transport17v2, so renewal-memory variables are unnecessary at this horizon/support
falsifiers.reaction_transport_insufficient: reaction_transport17v2 fails the preregistered confirmation closure threshold
falsifiers.conservation_failure: The proposed transport diagnostic predicts apparent system-level creation rather than relocation when tested in a transport-only conservation assay

interpretation_guard: A synthetic closure pass licenses only a reduced reaction-transport state representation on the tested support. It does not establish historical validity or empirical transport magnitudes.
